headline: Milk producers warn of return of blockade: If the Government does not reflect, we will not collect the milk
summary: The Kosovo Milk Producers Association said it suspended its decision not to collect milk, so collection continues until further notice. It warned of a return to the blockade if the government does not reflect on its position.
why: Dairy supply disruptions affect food processors and retail prices, and farm-gate disputes reflect the economic position of agricultural producers.
